(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (anti-transpose grid) (rotate-180 (transpose grid)))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (transpose grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= code 6) (flip-ud grid)]
            [(= code 7) (transpose grid)]
            [else (anti-transpose grid)]))
    (define div-row
      (find-first (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range 0 (cols g))))
                  (range 0 (rows g))))
    (define div-col
      (find-first (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range 0 (rows g))))
                  (range 0 (cols g))))
    (define tl (subgrid g 0 0 (- div-row 1) (- div-col 1)))
    (define tr (subgrid g 0 (+ div-col 1) (- div-row 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
    (define bl (subgrid g (+ div-row 1) 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- div-col 1)))
    (define code
      (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? (transform-code tl t) tr)) (list 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8))))
        (if hit hit 1)))
    (transform-code bl code)))
